code: nul_terminated_data = (unsigned char *) g_strndup ((const gchar *) data, size);
note: Fuzzer-controlled bytes are copied into a NUL-terminated string that drives the ISO 8601 parser.
The parser scans the attacker-controlled string to locate the date/time separator and determine the date substring length.
The date parser assumes the date substring has the expected separator layout before indexing fixed positions; malformed but length-matching input can violate this safety expectation.
The implementation dereferences fixed offsets into the date substring, which can read past the end of a too-short or malformed buffer and trigger the reported heap-buffer-overflow read.
